opening.argument: The video introduces WLTC as a product connecting Litecoin with Ethereum’s DeFi ecosystem and describes a conversion process: users send Litecoin to a custodian, who mints an equivalent amount of WLTC. It promotes trading WLTC on COINUT and says users can earn interest or yield through DeFi protocols. Those are product and use claims, not a specified return offer. The cited material gives no rate, guarantee, terms, or demonstrated outcome for that yield, and the described conversion alone does not establish a deceptive-return mechanism.

citations.quote: WLTC lets you enjoy all the benefits of #Litecoin with the flexibility of Ethereum’s DeFi ecosystem!
When you want to convert your Litecoin into WLTC, you simply send it to a WLTC custodian, who will then mint the equivalent amount of WLTC tokens
Start trading WLTC today on COINUT
with WLTC, you can earn interest or yield through various DeFi protocols
